raw_text:
Below is a 12-week strength program starting 2026-06-01, phased around a predictable 28‑day cycle with flow days 1–3 restricted (no high intensity, no heavy Valsalva, no jumping). It assumes three strength days per week plus optional low-intensity recovery on other days. We’ll use a repeating 4-week mesocycle aligned to her cycle, then progress over 3 mesocycles (Weeks 1–4, 5–8, 9–12). Each week lists exact sessions and loads relative to RPE (rating of perceived exertion) or %1RM. On flow days (cycle_day 1–3), sessions are modified to be low-intensity, low intra‑abdominal pressure, more mobility/core/breathing and light tempos. Outside flow, normal progressive strength work.

Key principles
- Cycle-aware periodization: 
  - Flow (cycle_day 1–3): Low intensity, low load (≤ RPE 5), no bracing/straining, no jumping. Emphasize mobility, diaphragmatic breathing, gentle core, light blood-flow work.
  - Follicular (post-flow days 4–13): Highest loading and progression. Emphasize main lifts, strength and power accessories.
  - Ovulatory window (days ~14–16): Maintain intensity but respect any mid-cycle discomfort; keep technique strict.
  - Luteal (days 17–28): Keep volume, slightly reduce peak intensity; add more submax accessories, deload in the final 2–3 days pre-flow if she reports symptoms.
- Sessions: 3x/week strength (Mon/Wed/Fri by default). Optional LISS walking/cycling, mobility on off days.
- Main lifts: Back squat, deadlift, horizontal press, vertical press, hinge, pull variations. Use RPE and % ranges to adapt day-to-day.
- Breathing/bracing: Outside flow, use standard bracing. During flow, avoid heavy Valsalva; use controlled exhale through concentric.
- Tempo notation: e.g., 3-0-3 = 3 sec eccentric, no pause, 3 sec concentric.

Cycle mapping across the 12 weeks
- Her last period: 2026-05-01. With 28-day cycles, flow windows that impact this plan:
  - Cycle starting 2026-05-29: flow days ~May 29–31 (before program start).
  - Cycle starting 2026-06-26: flow days Jun 26–28 (affects Week 4).
  - Cycle starting 2026-07-24: flow days Jul 24–26 (affects Week 8).
  - Cycle starting 2026-08-21: flow days Aug 21–23 (affects Week 12).
We’ll align deloads and low-intensity days to those flow windows.

Global structure across 12 weeks
- Mesocycle 1 (Weeks 1–4; Jun 1–28): Build base, technique, linear load increases; Week 4 coincides with flow—planned deload/light week.
- Mesocycle 2 (Weeks 5–8; Jun 29–Jul 26): Intensification; Week 8 deload coincides with flow.
- Mesocycle 3 (Weeks 9–12; Jul 27–Aug 23): Peak strength and rep-PRs; Week 12 deload/test-lite coincides with flow.

Session templates
- Day A (Lower priority): Squat focus + unilateral + trunk.
- Day B (Upper priority): Bench/row focus + vertical press/pull + arms.
- Day C (Hinge priority): Deadlift focus + posterior chain + carries.
On flow days, swap to Recovery/Mobility template (detailed below) if a planned strength day lands on cycle_day 1–3.

Warm-up (all sessions)
- 5–8 min easy cardio; mobility: 90/90 hips, cat-cow, thoracic rotations.
- Pelvic floor/diaphragm synergy: 3 sets of 5–6 breaths (360° breathing), gentle pelvic floor relaxation on inhale, light engagement on exhale (during flow) and normal bracing outside flow.

Recovery and monitoring
- Sleep: 7–9 h/night.
- Hydration: 30–35 ml/kg/day; a bit more premenstrually if bloating.
- During flow: Consider heat pack post-session 10–15 min; magnesium glycinate 200–400 mg nightly if cleared; NSAIDs only per GP advice.
- RPE auto-regulation: If pain or cramping >3/10, keep all work ≤ RPE 5 and use recovery template.
- Optional LISS: 20–30 min walks or easy cycling 2–4x/week (avoid on severe cramp days if uncomfortable).
- Core: Avoid heavy breath-holding and high IAP during flow; favor dead-bugs, side planks, bird-dogs.

Nutrition notes (general; not medical advice)
- Protein: ~1.6–2.2 g/kg/day.
- Carbs: Moderate-high on harder lower-body days; slightly higher in late follicular/ovulatory when intensity peaks.
- Pre-flow/luteal: Prioritize fiber, complex carbs, hydration, electrolytes; consider smaller, more frequent meals if GI sensitivity rises.
- During flow: Gentle iron-rich foods if tolerated; warm fluids; avoid large caffeine spikes if they worsen cramps.

12-week plan (starting Monday 2026-06-01)

Week 1 (Jun 1–7) — Follicular (days ~4–10): Build base
- Day A (Mon): Back Squat 4x6 @ RPE 6–7; DB Bulgarian Split Squat 3x8/side; Hip Thrust 3x10 @ RPE 7; Copenhagen Side Plank 3x20s/side; Calf Raise 3x12; Breathing 3x5.
- Day B (Wed): Bench Press 4x6 @ RPE 6–7; 1-Arm DB Row 4x8/side; Seated DB OHP 3x8 @ RPE 7; Lat Pulldown 3x10; Cable Face Pull 3x12; Pallof Press 3x12/side.
- Day C (Fri): Conventional Deadlift 4x5 @ RPE 6–7; Rear-Foot Elevated Split Squat 3x8/side; RDL 3x8 @ RPE 7; Farmer Carry 4x30m; Side Plank 3x30s/side.

Week 2 (Jun 8–14) — Late follicular/ovulatory: Progress loading
- Day A (Mon): Back Squat 5x5 @ RPE 7; Walking Lunge 3x10/side; Hip Thrust 4x8 @ RPE 7–8; Adductor Rocks 2x10; Calf Raise 4x10.
- Day B (Wed): Bench Press 5x5 @ RPE 7; Chest-Supported Row 4x8; Standing OHP 4x5 @ RPE 7; Pull-Up/Assisted 4x5–8; Cable External Rotation 3x12; Dead-Bug 3x8/side.
- Day C (Fri): Deadlift 5x4 @ RPE 7; Front-Foot Elevated Split Squat 3x10/side; Back Extension 3x12; Kettlebell Suitcase Carry 3x40m/side; Stir-the-Pot 3x8/side.

Week 3 (Jun 15–21) — Early luteal: Hold intensity, add volume
- Day A (Mon): Back Squat 4x4 @ RPE 7–8; Pause (2s) Goblet Squat 3x8; Hip Thrust 4x8 @ RPE 8; Copenhagen 3x25s; Seated Calf 3x12–15.
- Day B (Wed): Bench Press 4x4 @ RPE 7–8; 1-Arm Row 4x8; Push Press or Strict Press 4x4 @ RPE 7; Chin-Up/Assisted 4x6–8; Face Pull 3x15; Side Plank 3x35s/side.
- Day C (Fri): Deadlift 4x3 @ RPE 7–8; RDL 3x8; Reverse Lunge 3x10/side; Farmer Carry 4x35m; Pallof Press 3x12/side.

Week 4 (Jun 22–28) — Flow begins Jun 26–28: Deload/flow modifications
- Day A (Mon; pre-flow): Back Squat 3x5 @ RPE 6; DB Split Squat 2x8/side; Hip Thrust 2x10 @ RPE 6; Core 2x10 gentle.
- Day B (Wed; pre-flow): Bench 3x5 @ RPE 6; Chest-Supported Row 3x8; Seated DB OHP 2x8 @ RPE 6; Lat Pulldown 2x10; Breathing 3x5.
- Day C (Fri; cycle_day 1): Recovery/Mobility Session (no heavy loads, no Valsalva, no jumping)
  - 8–10 min easy bike or walk
  - Mobility flow 15–20 min: hip circles, adductor rock backs, thoracic rotations
  - Light circuits (2–3 rounds): Bodyweight box squat 2x10 (3-0-3 tempo), Glute bridge 2x12 (2-1-2), Band row 2x12, Bird-dog 2x8/side, Dead-bug 2x8/side
  - Breathing with heat pack after

Week 5 (Jun 29–Jul 5) — Follicular: Rebuild intensity
- Day A (Mon): Back Squat 5x5 @ RPE 7; Hip Thrust 4x8 @ RPE 7–8; Bulgarian Split Squat 3x8/side; Calf 4x12; Side Plank 3x30–40s.
- Day B (Wed): Bench 5x5 @ RPE 7; 1-Arm Row 4x8; Strict OHP 4x5 @ RPE 7; Pull-Up/Assisted 4x6–8; Face Pull 3x12–15; Pallof 3x12/side.
- Day C (Fri): Deadlift 5x4 @ RPE 7; RDL 3x8; Reverse Lunge 3x10/side; Farmer Carry 4x35–40m; Stir-the-Pot 3x8–10/side.

Week 6 (Jul 6–12) — Late follicular/ovulatory: Push for small PRs
- Day A (Mon): Back Squat 4x4 @ RPE 7.5–8; Pause Goblet 3x8; Hip Thrust 4x6–8 @ RPE 8; Copenhagen 3x25–30s; Calf 4x10–12.
- Day B (Wed): Bench 4x4 @ RPE 7.5–8; Chest-Supported Row 4x8; Push Press 4x3–4 @ RPE 7–7.5; Chin-Up/Assisted 4x5–7; External Rotation 3x12; Dead-bug 3x10/side.
- Day C (Fri): Deadlift 4x3 @ RPE 7.5–8; Front-Foot Elevated Split Squat 3x8–10/side; Back Extension 3x12–15; Suitcase Carry 3x40–50m/side; Pallof 3x12–15/side.

Week 7 (Jul 13–19) — Early luteal: Keep intensity submax, add volume
- Day A (Mon): Back Squat 5x3 @ RPE 7–7.5; Walking Lunge 3x10/side; Hip Thrust 4x8 @ RPE 7.5–8; Seated Calf 4x12–15.
- Day B (Wed): Bench 5x3 @ RPE 7–7.5; 1-Arm Row 4x10; Strict OHP 4x4 @ RPE 7; Lat Pulldown 4x8–10; Face Pull 3x15; Side Plank 3x40s.
- Day C (Fri): Deadlift 5x2–3 @ RPE 7–7.5; RDL 3x8–10; Step-Up 3x10/side; Farmer Carry 4x40m; Hollow Hold 3x20–30s.

Week 8 (Jul 20–26) — Flow Jul 24–26: Deload/flow modifications
- Day A (Mon; pre-flow): Back Squat 3x4 @ RPE 6; DB Split Squat 2x8/side; Hip Thrust 2x8–10 @ RPE 6; Core 2x10 gentle.
- Day B (Wed; pre-flow): Bench 3x4 @ RPE 6; Row 3x8; Seated DB OHP 2x8 @ RPE 6; Pulldown 2x10; Breathing 3x5.
- Day C (Fri; cycle_day 2): Recovery/Mobility Session (same as Week 4 Day C).

Week 9 (Jul 27–Aug 2) — Follicular: Peak mesocycle begins
- Day A (Mon): Back Squat 5x4 @ RPE 7.5–8; Hip Thrust 4x6–8 @ RPE 8; Bulgarian Split Squat 3x8/side; Calf 4x12; Pallof 3x12/side.
- Day B (Wed): Bench 5x4 @ RPE 7.5–8; Chest-Supported Row 4x8; Strict OHP 4x4 @ RPE 7.5; Pull-Up/Assisted 5x5–6; Face Pull 3x12–15; Dead-bug 3x10/side.
- Day C (Fri): Deadlift 5x3 @ RPE 7.5–8; RDL 3x6–8; Reverse Lunge 3x8–10/side; Suitcase Carry 3x50m/side; Side Plank 3x40–45s.

Week 10 (Aug 3–9) — Late follicular/ovulatory: Heaviest submax
- Day A (Mon): Back Squat 4x3 @ RPE 8; Optional top single @ RPE 7 then 3x3 @ RPE 7.5; Hip Thrust 4x6 @ RPE 8; Copenhagen 3x30s; Calf 4x10–12.
- Day B (Wed): Bench 4x3 @ RPE 8; Optional top single @ RPE 7 then 3x3 @ RPE 7.5; Row 4x8; Push Press 4x2–3 @ RPE 7–7.5; Chin-Up/Assisted 5x4–6; External Rotation 3x12.
- Day C (Fri): Deadlift 4x2–3 @ RPE 8; Optional top single @ RPE 7 then 3x2 @ RPE 7.5; Front-Foot Elevated Split Squat 3x8; Back Extension 3x12–15; Farmer Carry 4x50m.

Week 11 (Aug 10–16) — Early luteal: Consolidate, slight back-off
- Day A (Mon): Back Squat 5x3 @ RPE 7–7.5; Goblet Squat 3x8 (2s pause); Hip Thrust 3x8 @ RPE 7.5; Calf 3x12–15; Pallof 3x12/side.
- Day B (Wed): Bench 5x3 @ RPE 7–7.5; 1-Arm Row 4x10; Strict OHP 4x3–4 @ RPE 7; Pulldown 4x8–10; Face Pull 3x15; Side Plank 3x45s.
- Day C (Fri): Deadlift 5x2 @ RPE 7–7.5; RDL 3x8; Step-Up 3x10/side; Suitcase Carry 3x50–60m/side; Dead-bug 3x10/side.

Week 12 (Aug 17–23) — Flow Aug 21–23: Deload/test-lite with flow mods
- Day A (Mon; pre-flow): Back Squat 3x3 @ RPE 6–6.5; Hip Thrust 2x6–8 @ RPE 6; Split Squat 2x8/side; Gentle core 2x8–10.
- Day B (Wed; pre-flow): Bench 3x3 @ RPE 6–6.5; Row 3x8; Seated DB OHP 2x6–8 @ RPE 6; Pulldown 2x8–10; Breathing 3x5.
- Day C (Fri; cycle_day 1): Recovery/Mobility Session (same as Week 4 Day C). Optional easy technique work only if symptom-free: empty bar or very light goblet squat/hip hinge, RPE ≤4, no breath holds.

Progression guidance
- Load: When RPE target leaves 2–3 reps in reserve and form is solid, increase next set by 1–2.5 kg (upper) or 2.5–5 kg (lower). If sets exceed RPE target early, hold load for remaining sets.
- Rep PRs: In Weeks 6, 9–10, aim to add 1 rep on final set at same load if RPE allows instead of jumping load.
- Symptom autoregulation: On days with pelvic pressure/cramping outside flow, reduce all intensities to ≤ RPE 6 and switch any barbell braced lifts to dumbbell/kettlebell variations with exhale-through-lift cue.

Flow-day Recovery/Mobility template (for any strength day landing cycle_day 1–3)
- 8–10 min easy cardio
- Mobility 15–20 min: 
  - Cat-cow 2x8, child’s pose breathing 2x5 breaths
  - Hip openers: 90/90 transitions 2x6/side, adductor rock backs 2x10
  - Thoracic rotations 2x8/side
- Light circuit 2–3 rounds, all RPE ≤5, slow tempos:
  - Box squat to comfortable depth 10 reps (3-0-3)
  - Glute bridge 12 reps (2-1-2)
  - Banded row 12–15 reps
  - Bird-dog 8/side
  - Dead-bug 8/side
  - Side-lying thoracic windmill 6/side
- Finish: 5–6 min diaphragmatic breathing; optional heat pack.

Optional conditioning (non-flow)
- 1–2 sessions/week: 
  - LISS 20–30 min (walk, easy bike) or 
  - Tempo intervals 6–8x1 min @ RPE 6 with 1 min easy. Avoid HIIT on weeks 4, 8, 12 and during flow.

Check-ins and adjustments
- Track: RPEs, loads, symptom severity daily. 
- If any session coincides with unexpected severe symptoms, swap to Recovery/Mobility template.
- If a planned strength day falls exactly on flow_day 1–3, you may rearrange that week to place strength earlier and keep the flow-days light.
- After Week 12: If cycles remain regular and symptoms manageable, plan a new 12-week block with slightly higher starting loads, or a test week outside flow for new training max estimates.

This plan respects her medical guidance on flow days, leverages follicular windows for progression, and maintains continuity through each month.
